dialogues.speaker: Amber
dialogues.text: Hahaha, it's been ages since I've built a snowman — it's so fun! Still a little cold, though... Brrr... My fingers are numb...

dialogues.speaker: Eula
dialogues.text: Amber, if the cold is getting to you, there's always hot soup back at the camp. Take a rest if you need one. Don't put too much pressure on yourself.

dialogues.speaker: Joel
dialogues.text: So Amber really feels the cold, huh... but Aunty Eula, it doesn't seem to affect you at all.

dialogues.speaker: Eula
dialogues.text: Maybe it's because of our different capabilities. Elemental energy is... Ahem, sorry, not something you need to know about in any great detail. Simply put, it's because we have different abilities.

dialogues.speaker: Amber
dialogues.text: Yeah, harnessing the cold is definitely her specialty. In fact — in summertime, just standing next to her cools me down!

dialogues.speaker: Joel
dialogues.text: Huh... c—capability? I didn't really get it, but... never mind. I like snowmen too.

dialogues.speaker: Joel
dialogues.text: I, uh... really wish my dad could see them...

dialogues.speaker: Joel
dialogues.text: Hey, Traveler, it's you!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: How have things been going recently?

dialogues.speaker: Joel
dialogues.text: Things are going great! Dad still doesn't remember a ton of stuff, but I'm just happy to have his company!

dialogues.speaker: Joel
dialogues.text: I've found some toys that we used to play with together. Maybe he'll remember a couple more things once he sees them!

dialogues.speaker: Joel
dialogues.text: I mean, I'd be okay even if he doesn't remember everything. We'll find new toys to play with, and we'll make new memories together!

dialogues.speaker: Joel
dialogues.text: Like... Uh...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Like snowmen?

dialogues.speaker: Joel
dialogues.text: Yeah, like snowmen! I love 'em! And hide-and-seek, and building blocks, and reading stories...

dialogues.speaker: Joel
dialogues.text: The snow around here is super thick and white. We've already agreed to go make a snowman shaped like a fox later!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: See you around, then.

dialogues.speaker: Joel
dialogues.text: Yup, see you!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: He'll be fine.

dialogues.speaker: Joel
dialogues.text: Thanks... Well, you look like a Traveler. Will be you be going up the mountain to go on more adventures?

dialogues.speaker: Joel
dialogues.text: If you are, then please take this pocket watch with you.

dialogues.speaker: Joel
dialogues.text: An adventurer gave this to me. He said that it's a watch that brings you luck.

dialogues.speaker: Joel
dialogues.text: I wanted to give it to Daddy, but I could never find the chance...

dialogues.speaker: Joel
dialogues.text: If you're going up the mountain, you should take it. Hope it'll bring you good luck. Have a safe trip!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Take care of yourself now.

dialogues.speaker: Joel
dialogues.text: Yup, sure will!

dialogues.speaker: Joel
dialogues.text: Oh well, an adventurer gave this to me previously... He said that it's a watch that brings you luck.

dialogues.speaker: Joel
dialogues.text: I mean, I found Dad again, so I guess it must be a lucky watch after all!

dialogues.speaker: Joel
dialogues.text: I'll give it to you now. I sure hope it brings you as much luck as it did me!

dialogues.speaker: Joel
dialogues.text: Who's th— No, Daddy said that I should be more polite...

dialogues.speaker: Joel
dialogues.text: ...How do you do?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Your father?

dialogues.speaker: Joel
dialogues.text: Yup, he's an adventurer.

dialogues.speaker: Joel
dialogues.text: He said that he would come to pick me up and that we'd go see the snow together. But the time we arranged has come and gone, and he isn't here yet...

dialogues.speaker: Joel
dialogues.text: I thought that he must have found some rare and precious treasure map or something, which is why he hasn't come to find me yet. That has to be it, right?

dialogues.speaker: Joel
dialogues.text: So I came to Dragonspine by myself. If he's not going to come find me, then I'll go looking for him... Or so I thought...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: So, have you found him yet?

dialogues.speaker: Joel
dialogues.text: No... That Knight of Favonius over there said that he'd headed off for the mountain's summit...

dialogues.speaker: Joel
dialogues.text: I wanted to go search for him, but the Knight wouldn't let me. So I'm stuck here waiting for Daddy to come back.

dialogues.speaker: Joel
dialogues.text: I'll see him for sure, though. We promised to go see the snow together. There's no way that he'd break his promise.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: See you around then, kid.

dialogues.speaker: Joel
dialogues.text: Goodbye.

dialogues.speaker: Joel
dialogues.text: Well, I've seen the snow. Now all that's left is to find Daddy...
